headline: Outsourcing industry targets 15,000 jobs by 2030
summary: Outsource Fiji launched a five-year strategic plan for 2026 to 2030 targeting more than 15,000 jobs and up to $465 million in annual revenue. The plan was announced in Suva.
why: Business process outsourcing is a growing services export sector, and its growth affects employment and foreign-currency earnings in small economies.
